components.css: .ds-page { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 168px; padding: 8px 8px 6px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-page:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-2, #ecebe6) 70%, transparent); } .ds-page[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--accent-soft, #e3e8fb); } .ds-thumb { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-paper { width: 71%; height: 100%; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.07); } .ds-page[aria-selected='true'] .ds-paper { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #2847c4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-check { position: absolute; top: -4px; left: -4px; width: 24px; height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #2847c4); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #f4f3ef); } .ds-check svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text, #1d1d1b); } .ds-caption b { font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-caption span { color: var(--muted, #6c6b65); font-size: 12px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2847c4; }

narrative.overview:
PDF Studio is a calm, warm desk with paper on it. The desk (the background and every bar and panel) is flat, warm off-white and stays out of the way; the pages are white sheets with a soft shadow, the only things on screen with weight. Tools sit at the edges of the desk: a top bar, a context bar under it, and in the Details view a strip on the left and a panel on the right. The middle belongs to the pages.

The mood is calm, plain and paper-first. One blue accent, Ballpoint Blue, marks everything you can act on or have selected. Every other colour carries a fixed meaning (danger, privacy, highlight, which file a page comes from) and never decorates. Type is the system font at small, dense sizes, as in a native app. Motion is short and quiet: things settle into place, they don't perform.

Light and dark mode follow the system setting. In dark mode the desk turns to Night Desk; the pages stay white, because they are paper.
keyCharacteristics: Flat warm chrome, white paper with the only real shadow.
One interactive accent (Ballpoint Blue); all other hues are meanings.
System font, small sizes (12–17px), tabular numbers for anything counted.
Thin 1px borders and 8–10px corners; states shown by tint, not by weight.
Short ease-out motion (120–260ms), switched off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Ballpoint Blue is the only colour that means "you can act on this" or "this is selected". A new interactive state uses it; it never gets a second accent.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Red, pink, yellow, orange and the source colours each mean exactly one thing. Never use them for decoration, illustration or emphasis.

rules.name: The White Paper Rule
rules.body: The PDF page is always pure white with its paper shadow, in light and dark mode. Dark mode darkens the desk, never the paper.

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: No web fonts. The app must work offline and under a CSP that blocks other origins, and it should look native on every platform.

rules.name: The Counted Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that counts or changes (page numbers, rotation, counts, the page field, version) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Square Slot Rule
rules.body: Every thumbnail sits centred in a square slot, sized so the page fits in any rotation. Rotating a page turns it in place and never reflows the grid.

rules.name: The Only Paper Lifts Rule
rules.body: Only paper and floating layers (menus, toasts, dialogs, the drag ghost, hover tools) cast shadows. Never add a shadow to a bar, panel, card or button at rest.

dos: Do use the CSS custom properties in `src/styles.css` (`--accent`, `--surface`, …), so dark mode follows automatically.
Do keep Ballpoint Blue for interaction and selection only (The One Ink Rule).
Do keep pages white with the paper shadow in both modes (The White Paper Rule).

Do give buttons a visible label on desktop. Only universal icons (undo, redo, help, close) may be icon-only. Under 720px secondary buttons collapse to icons; every button keeps a label for screen readers and a `title`.
Do use `--ease-out` (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`) and 120–260ms for motion, and leave the global reduced-motion override in place.
Do use tabular figures for page numbers and counts.
donts: Don't add shadows to bars, panels, cards or buttons at rest (The Only Paper Lifts Rule).
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use the signal colours decoratively.
Don't load web fonts, icon fonts or anything from another origin; icons are inline SVG from the sprite in `index.html`.

Don't hardcode colours. Existing exceptions to clean up: the selection frame (`.pick`, `.draft.select`, `.draft` background) hardcodes light-mode Ballpoint Blue, and the mark delete dot uses its own red instead of `--danger`.
Don't make inputs smaller than 16px text on phones.
